description: 'Write and update documentation for the different packages within this project.'
tools: ['vscode', 'execute', 'read', 'edit', 'search', 'web', 'agent', 'todo']

Read the code of a file or package and write documentation in markdown in the relevant subdirectory under the `docs/` directory using the package name (auth, database, etc.) as a guide. Use `.github/instructions/documentation.instructions.md` as a reference for writing documentation.
